sources.title: Aggregation with generalized mixture operators using weighting functions
sources.authors: Ricardo Alberto Marques Pereira; Rita Almeida Ribeiro
sources.inspected: Institution draft header/abstract, sections3-5 pages8-14, definitions and linear/quadratic constraint proofs
sources.identity_resolution: Actual draft header agrees with publisher title; DOI uses (02), not erroneous (00) in secondary citation. Crossref primary registration matches (02); (00) lookup failed.
sources.overlap: Normalized input-dependent weights can break monotonicity; sufficient generating-function conditions and exact parameter conditions for those sufficient restrictions.
sources.distinction: Its satisfaction values and their own weights vary together on a cube; current fixed readout varies normalized masses under a declared absorbing rate vector/cone. No theorem equivalence or non-equivalence over all transformations proved.

sources.title: Weighted means and weighting functions
sources.inspected: Definitions equations2-5; monotonicity section3 pp155-157 including derivative6 and sufficient C1-C3
sources.overlap: Standard derivative restrictions for normalized variable weighting; explicit warnings that conditions may be sufficient and non-exhaustive.
sources.distinction: Different varying quantities/domain; no generic normalized-monotonicity or derivative-principle novelty here.

sources.title: Vacuum Stability Conditions From Copositivity Criteria
sources.author: Kristjan Kannike
sources.inspected: Section2 p3 equations1-2 and adjacent scope for 2x2 versus higher-order copositivity
sources.overlap: The binary nonnegative-quadratic criterion is established; not invented here.
sources.distinction: Only the model-specific support-two reduction and resulting absorbing-readout parameter interpretation are candidate contributions, with priority open.

sources.title: Extreme Points of Moment Sets
sources.author: Gerhard Winkler
sources.inspected: Publisher abstract and metadata only; full theorem proof not inspected
sources.overlap: Finite-moment extreme-point methods are established; the elementary two-equality finite LP argument is stated and proved directly here, not claimed new.

consequence: Position exact fixed-rate/conic characterization and co-ordering corollary as working model-specific results. No first copositivity algorithm, first normalized monotonic readout or empirical predictor gain.
